abstract.text: Explicitly set whether this Accessibility element responds to user interaction and would thus be interacted with by technologies such as Switch Control, Voice Control or Full Keyboard Access.

If this is not set, the value is inferred from the traits of the Accessibility element, the presence of Accessibility actions on the element, or the presence of gestures on the element or containing views.
